# Heading styles reference

Covers authored opening spacing, a declared replacement for a built-in heading
style, derived styles, a paragraph using a heading style, and an explicit empty
style reference. The empty reference suppresses the paragraph style; omission
selects the heading fallback. An otherwise unused fallback may still be declared.

The model and every captured package part are compared. Declared styles keep
their authored properties; they do not receive missing fallback properties.
Real Word rendering and layout review remain **unreviewed**.
